name: battlebots-arena
description: BattleBots Arena packaged with Capacitor for iOS.

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "BattleBots Arena" com.schadegg.arena --web-dir www
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
